content.short: Aboard Exchange is an order book-based decentralized derivatives protocol offering perpetuals and options on Arbitrum.
content.description: Aboard Exchange is a comprehensive decentralized derivatives platform initially launched on the Arbitrum network. It provides a professional trading experience through an order book model, supporting token perpetuals, index perpetuals, options, and spot trading with up to 25x leverage. The protocol utilizes a cross-margin system to enhance capital efficiency and minimize liquidation risks for traders. With its native ABE token, Aboard Exchange integrates governance and utility features, aiming to bridge the gap between the speed of centralized exchanges and the security of decentralized finance.
